'''Allyuen''' was a remote [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Allyuen system/Legends|Allyuen system]], located in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
Allyuen was a subzero temperature planet. It was one of the four [[Mining Worlds/Legends|Mining Worlds]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], along with [[Burnin Konn/Legends|Burnin Konn]], and [[Tokmia/Legends|Tokmia]],<ref name="GG:HatGJ" /><ref name="TEA" /> controlled by the [[Figg conglomerate]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet possessed [[Chromite/Legends|chromite]] resources but the mining operations on Allyuen were barely profitable.<ref name="GG:HatGJ" /><ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Empire suspected that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] might be based on the world after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'', attached to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], dispatched a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] to Allyuen in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] to search for the hidden [[Echo Base/Legends|Rebel base]].<ref name="GG3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Allyuen was first mentioned in the [[The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization|published script]] of [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]. Captain [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Needa]] mentions it as one of the destinations for his ship's probe droids.<ref name="radio script">[[The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''The Empire Strikes Back'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref> That portion of the scene was cut from the final version of the radio drama,<ref name="Freedom's Winter">{{ESBRadio|Freedom's Winter}}</ref> but after the script's publication, other [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] sources began to make mention of the planet.<ref name="GG3" />

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Allyuen in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]], which is actually located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
